notes: Troubleshooting v357 addresses browser-specific startup stalls caused by mixed or stale troubleshooting assets. The troubleshooting shell now installs its recovery monitor before any external diagnostic script, adds a visible Repair local cache action that unregisters same-origin service workers and deletes ServoForge runtime caches without clearing localStorage or saved ServoForge workspace data, gives every troubleshooting asset a v357 cache key, and loads the troubleshooting script chain with defer so one parser-blocking request cannot leave the rendered shell silently frozen before diagnostics. The v356 compact-context startup guard remains in place before troubleshooting-app.js, and all existing source-backed fault-isolation logic is unchanged.
